ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached diagram shows seven marked points equally spaced around a circle, with straight segments drawn between every pair of points. Thus the picture represents a regular 7-gon inscribed in a circle, together with all of its edges and diagonals, i.e. all 21 unordered chords among the 7 vertices. Reasoning: The circle has radius 1. In a regular 7-gon, any chord length depends only on the cyclic separation k between its endpoints. Since separations k and 7-k give the same chord length, the distinct separations are k=1,2,3. For each k, there are 7 chords of that length. The chord length for separation k is 2 sin(kπ/7). Therefore the required sum is 7[(2sin(π/7))^4 + (2sin(2π/7))^4 + (2sin(3π/7))^4]. This equals 7·16[sin^4(π/7)+sin^4(2π/7)+sin^4(3π/7)]. Using sin^4 x = (3 - 4cos 2x + cos 4x)/8, we get sin^4(π/7)+sin^4(2π/7)+sin^4(3π/7) = [9 - 4(cos(2π/7)+cos(4π/7)+cos(6π/7)) + (cos(4π/7)+cos(8π/7)+cos(12π/7))]/8. The cosine sums are both cos(2π/7)+cos(4π/7)+cos(6π/7) = -1/2, since the second sum is the same set modulo symmetry. Hence the sine-fourth-power sum is [9 - 4(-1/2) - 1/2]/8 = 21/16. So the total is 7·16·21/16 = 147.

method.method_draft: First describe the image as a complete graph on the 7 vertices of a regular heptagon inscribed in a circle. From the text, set the unit-circle vertices as complex numbers 1, ζ, ζ^2, ..., ζ^6 where ζ = e^{2πi/7}. The desired sum is over unordered pairs {i,j} of |ζ^i - ζ^j|^4. Instead compute the ordered-pair sum and divide by 2. For difference m=i-j, |ζ^i-ζ^j|^4 = |1-ζ^m|^4 = (2 - ζ^m - ζ^{-m})^2 = 6 - 4(ζ^m+ζ^{-m}) + ζ^{2m}+ζ^{-2m}. For ordered pairs, each m modulo 7 occurs 7 times, including m=0 which contributes 0. Sum over m=0,...,6; the nonconstant root-of-unity sums vanish, leaving 7·(6·7)=294. Divide by 2 for unordered pairs to obtain 147.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个圆，圆周上有7个黑色顶点，所有顶点之间都画出了线段，所以它可以看作正七边形7个顶点形成的完全图；这些线段包括正七边形的边和对角线，共 C(7,2)=21 条。

推理：按题意，正七边形内接于单位圆。令7个顶点为复数 1, ζ, ζ^2, ..., ζ^6，其中 ζ=e^(2πi/7)。要求的是所有无序点对 {i,j} 的 |ζ^i-ζ^j|^4 之和。

先计算有序点对 (i,j) 的和，最后除以2。设 m=i-j mod 7，则 |ζ^i-ζ^j|^4=|1-ζ^m|^4。又 |1-ζ^m|^2=(1-ζ^m)(1-ζ^(-m))=2-ζ^m-ζ^(-m)，所以 |1-ζ^m|^4=(2-ζ^m-ζ^(-m))^2=6-4(ζ^m+ζ^(-m))+ζ^(2m)+ζ^(-2m)。

在所有49个有序点对中，每个差值 m=0,1,...,6 都出现7次。因此有序和为 7 * Σ_{m=0}^6 [6-4(ζ^m+ζ^(-m))+ζ^(2m)+ζ^(-2m)]。根之和满足 Σζ^m=Σζ^(-m)=Σζ^(2m)=Σζ^(-2m)=0，所以括号内总和只剩 Σ6=42。有序和为 7*42=294。

无序点对每条线段被计算了两次，因此所求和为 294/2=147。
